25-2. Contract teachers shall be notified of their employment status for the ensuing year no later than April 1st.

ARTICLE 26

COACHES

26-1. MEETINGS: Association- Board Athletic Committee—The Board and the Association agree that, in order to achieve a more flexible and meaningful athletic program, members of the Board of Education's Athletic Committee will meet with representatives of the Association no less than three (3) times per year, (at least two (2) of these meetings shall be before January 1 of each school year), for purposes of discussing and planning activities of mutual concern.

26-2. EVALUATION: The responsibility of evaluating a coach's performance of duty during a game and in his preparation for a game shall be placed on the Director of Health and Physical Education—the Assistant Director of Health and Physical Education, the Principal of his school, and the Faculty Advisor of Athletics, and in those cases where applicable, the Supervisor of Girls Physical Education.

26-3. RE-EMPLOYMENT: Coaches will not be required to submit a yearly application for reemployment. Coaches will be notified of their reemployment within sixty (60) days after the conclusion of the season.

26-4. ADVANCEMENT: When a vacancy occurs in any Head Coaching position, appointment shall be given to an assistant coach active in that particular sport, based on seniority, experience, and evaluation reports within the system.

26-5. FILLING VACANCIES: Whenever a vacancy exists in a coaching position, notice of such vacancy shall be posted in all schools inviting those qualified to apply in writing. The written application shall be sent to the Director or Assistant Director of Health and Physical Education.
